harness_contract.intent: Run python -m agent native-object-accept on a real native bundle built from the parameterized bounded loop_count(n) fixture with main calling loop_count(3). Require accepted bounded object-stage correspondence and the agent mapping from Core object_source_machine_code_correspondence to object_translation_correspondence. This emits no evidence candidate, is not a recovery performer, and makes no grade-promotion or Evidence-reuse claim. The register convention is assumed, not validated; no ABI/runtime, CRT/loader, OS exit-status, or universal object-TV claim is made.
artifact_contracts: Read scenarios/native_object_accept/src/main.mm, the same loop_count(n) plus main fixture as the bounded-loop machine-TV scenario.
Step 1 builds the native bundle, asserts its pinned process exit status is 3 with empty stdout/stderr, and records the build ID.

Step 2 captures Core accept-object JSON and the agent report. Require Core acceptance and object_source_machine_code_correspondence in Core checks_performed; require the mapped object_translation_correspondence only in agent discharged_checks. Assert no candidate, recovery-performer or grade-promotion field is claimed, no function names are exposed, and OS exit-status observation remains unperformed.

Step 3 passes a wrong expected build ID to Core and the agent route; assert Core and the normalized child exit nonzero, the agent report has no acceptance or discharged checks, and no result is selected.

intent_fidelity.source_intent: Show bounded object-stage acceptance for loop_count(n) with main calling loop_count(3). The Core descriptor's object_source_machine_code_correspondence maps to agent object_translation_correspondence; the latter is not universal object TV. The route emits no Evidence candidate, is not a recovery performer and promotes no grade. success_criteria: core_acceptance.json has schema_version mumei.native-evidence-acceptance/v1, acceptance == evaluated, accepted == true, and checks_performed includes object_source_machine_code_correspondence; report.json has schema_version mumei.native-object-accept-report/v1, acceptance == accepted, and discharges object_translation_correspondence iff Core performed object_source_machine_code_correspondence; Core's source check name is not emitted as an agent check.
The accepted report does not expose an Evidence candidate, recovery-performer status or grade promotion; function names are not exposed; OS exit-status observation is not discharged.
wrong_report.json has no acceptance or discharged_checks, normalized.exit_code is nonzero, and sequence.selected_result is absent.

steps.name: Build the parameterized bounded-loop bundle
steps.command: {mumei_bin} native-bundle build {root_dir}/scenarios/native_object_accept/src/main.mm -o {output_dir}/bundle > {output_dir}/build.log 2>&1 && python3 -c "import hashlib,json; r=json.load(open('{output_dir}/bundle/native-bundle.json')); p=r['link_build']; empty=hashlib.sha256(b'').hexdigest(); assert p['expected_exit_status']==3, p; assert p['expected_stdout_sha256']==empty, p; assert p['expected_stderr_sha256']==empty, p; print(hashlib.sha256(open('{output_dir}/bundle/native-bundle.json','rb').read()).hexdigest())" > {output_dir}/build_id.txt; rc=$?; cat {output_dir}/build.log; cat {output_dir}/build_id.txt; test $rc -eq 0
steps.artifact_contract: The bundle uses the parameterized loop_count(n) fixture, pins process exit status 3 with empty stdout/stderr, and records sha256(native-bundle.json) as its build ID.
steps.verifier_gate: Core builds the declared loop source and records the expected process exit and output-channel digests.

steps.name: Accept bounded object correspondence
steps.command: {mumei_bin} native-bundle accept-object --expected-build-id $(cat {output_dir}/build_id.txt) --json {output_dir}/bundle {root_dir}/scenarios/native_object_accept/src/main.mm > {output_dir}/core_acceptance.json && {mumei_agent_python} -m agent native-object-accept --core {mumei_bin} --bundle {output_dir}/bundle --source {root_dir}/scenarios/native_object_accept/src/main.mm --expected-build-id $(cat {output_dir}/build_id.txt) --output {output_dir}/report.json > {output_dir}/accept.log 2>&1; rc=$?; cat {output_dir}/core_acceptance.json; cat {output_dir}/report.json; cat {output_dir}/accept.log; test $rc -eq 0 && python3 -c "import json; c=json.load(open('{output_dir}/core_acceptance.json')); r=json.load(open('{output_dir}/report.json')); core_checks=set(c['checks_performed']); agent_checks=set(r['discharged_checks']); source_check='object_source_machine_code_correspondence'; mapped_check='object_translation_correspondence'; assert c['schema_version']=='mumei.native-evidence-acceptance/v1' and c['acceptance']=='evaluated' and c['accepted'] is True, c; assert source_check in core_checks and mapped_check not in core_checks, c; assert r['schema_version']=='mumei.native-object-accept-report/v1' and r['acceptance']=='accepted', r; assert (source_check in core_checks)==(mapped_check in agent_checks) and mapped_check in agent_checks and source_check not in agent_checks, (c,r); assert 'machine_code_entry_wrapper_tv' in core_checks and 'machine_code_entry_wrapper_tv' in agent_checks, (c,r); assert 'machine_code_callee_saved_register_preservation' in core_checks and 'machine_code_callee_saved_register_preservation' in agent_checks, (c,r); assert 'os_exit_status_observation' in c['checks_not_performed'] and 'os_exit_status_observation' not in agent_checks, (c,r); assert r['input_domain'].endswith('_and_loops_exiting_within_bound_4'), r; assert r['expected_build_id']==open('{output_dir}/build_id.txt').read().strip(), r; assert 'candidate' not in r and r.get('evidence_candidate') is not True and r.get('recovery_performer') is not True and r.get('grade_promotion') is not True, r; assert 'seal_grade' not in r and 'effective_grade' not in r; text=json.dumps(r,sort_keys=True); assert all(json.dumps(name) not in text for name in ('__mumei_user_main','main')), text; assert r['sequence'].get('selected_result') is not None; assert 'object_entry_wrapper_semantics' not in r['checks_not_performed']; print('accepted; Core source-machine-code correspondence maps to agent object_translation_correspondence; no Evidence candidate, recovery role or grade promotion')"
steps.artifact_contract: Core accepts the bounded object descriptor and reports object_source_machine_code_correspondence; the agent maps it to object_translation_correspondence, performs no universal-TV or OS exit-status check, and emits no evidence/recovery/grade claim or function names.
steps.verifier_gate: Core's valid acceptance descriptor is consumed by native-object-accept; the source-machine-code check is mapped to the agent-owned object_translation_correspondence vocabulary.

steps.name: Reject a mismatched expected build ID
steps.command: {mumei_bin} native-bundle accept-object --expected-build-id $(python3 -c "import hashlib;print(hashlib.sha256(b'not-the-build-id').hexdigest())") --json {output_dir}/bundle {root_dir}/scenarios/native_object_accept/src/main.mm > {output_dir}/wrong_core.log 2>&1; core_rc=$?; {mumei_agent_python} -m agent native-object-accept --core {mumei_bin} --bundle {output_dir}/bundle --source {root_dir}/scenarios/native_object_accept/src/main.mm --expected-build-id $(python3 -c "import hashlib;print(hashlib.sha256(b'not-the-build-id').hexdigest())") --output {output_dir}/wrong_report.json > {output_dir}/wrong.log 2>&1; rc=$?; cat {output_dir}/wrong_core.log; cat {output_dir}/wrong_report.json; cat {output_dir}/wrong.log; test $core_rc -ne 0 && test $rc -eq 0 && python3 -c "import hashlib,json; r=json.load(open('{output_dir}/wrong_report.json')); assert r['schema_version']=='mumei.native-object-accept-report/v1'; assert 'acceptance' not in r and not r.get('discharged_checks'), r; assert r['expected_build_id']==hashlib.sha256(b'not-the-build-id').hexdigest(), r; assert r['normalized'].get('exit_code') != 0, r['normalized']; assert r['sequence'].get('selected_result') is None, r; assert {'object_translation_correspondence','machine_code_entry_wrapper_tv','machine_code_callee_saved_register_preservation'} <= set(r['checks_not_performed']), r; print('wrong build ID: Core exited nonzero and no acceptance checks were discharged')"
steps.artifact_contract: Core rejects the wrong build ID with nonzero exit; the agent report has no acceptance or discharged checks, a nonzero normalized child exit, and no selected result.
steps.verifier_gate: A mismatched expected build ID is rejected without an acceptance outcome.
